paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah ben Yair, a Tanna, Yevamot 86b; Rabbi Yehoshua ben Yair, [Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Taanit.3.4.5).
The well-known Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman cites Yevamot 86b. [The named occurrence at Yevamot 80b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.80b.4) has Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel citing Rabbi Yehudah ben Yair, as in [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1648&lang=en). The Yerushalmi gives [Rabbi Yehoshua ben Yair](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1773&lang=en) citing Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair. The biblical Yair is a separate notice.
